Title: Admin UI and role-based access control

Summary:
Add an admin interface and RBAC so club admins can manage activities, members, and events.

Acceptance criteria:
- Admin pages for managing Activities, Members, Events, Certificates.
- Role definitions: `admin`, `organizer`, `member` with permissions.
- Audit/logging for admin actions.

Implementation notes:
- Use a simple admin UI built with the existing static files or leverage a third-party admin package.
